gaps.sentence: All ___ must wear identity badges at all times on site.
gaps.explanation: 'Personnel' = the employees of an organisation; 'personal' is an adjective.

gaps.sentence: The consultant will ___ us on every stage of the merger.
gaps.explanation: 'Advise' is the verb; 'advice' is the noun.

gaps.sentence: I ___ seeing that man somewhere before.
The committee will ___ your application at its May meeting.
gaps.explanation: The finite verb slot needs 'consider'; 'considerable' means large.

gaps.sentence: The hospital is ___ the city centre.
gaps.explanation: 'Near' is a preposition before a place; 'nearly' is an adverb of degree meaning almost; 'close' needs 'to'.

gaps.sentence: The comedian was so ___ that everyone cried with laughter.
gaps.explanation: 'Funny' is an adjective describing something that makes you laugh; 'fun' describes enjoyable experiences.

gaps.sentence: We ___ all major credit cards at the box office.
gaps.explanation: 'Accept' means to take or agree to something offered; 'except' means not including.

gaps.sentence: I was so ___ when I forgot her name in front of everyone.
gaps.hint: how you feel in an awkward social situation
gaps.explanation: 'Embarrassed' describes short-term discomfort in a social situation; 'ashamed' implies guilt about wrongdoing.
